title: EventBus Envelope (v1)
description: Every event published to the AutoResearch EventBus carries this envelope. The envelope is REQUIRED on every event; the payload structure is event_type-specific.

event_id.description: UUID v4. Used for idempotency: same event_id received twice MUST be processed exactly once.

session_id.description: UUID v4 of the session this event belongs to. Determines the Redis stream key: events:{session_id}.

event_type.description: Dot-separated event name, e.g. 'coder.module_implemented'. Used to look up schema + emitter whitelist.

emitter.description: Identity of the publishing process. The 'system' emitter is reserved for broker-library-synthesized events (e.g. policy_violation agent.failed). 'ResearchOrchestrator' is the engine state machine; the remaining names are the AutoResearch pipeline agents plus 'MOSS' (cross-cutting oversight).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the event was created.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema. Allows the broker to choose the right schema when validating.

cost_delta.description: USD cost contributed by this event, decimal with up to 6 fractional digits. Stored as string to avoid float precision loss. Events without LLM cost set this to '0'.

causation_id.description: Optional. The event_id of the event that directly caused this one. Enables event-chain tracing for debugging.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Validated against the corresponding payload schema (e.g. coder.module_implemented.v1.schema.json).
